name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for a requested time slot. It only checks: it does not save, create or change any booking. All times are whole minutes since midnight, from 0 (00:00) to 1440 (24:00), so 10:00 is 600 and 15:15 is 915. Returns Available or Unavailable according to the booking rules (slot inside the day and after the current time, at most 120 minutes, room not blocked, no overlap with existing bookings; touching bookings are allowed).

start.description: Requested start of the booking, in whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end of the booking, in whole minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time, in whole minutes since midnight (08:00 = 480).

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked (for example for maintenance), false otherwise.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room. May be empty.

start.description: Start of the existing booking, in minutes since midnight.

end.description: End of the existing booking, in minutes since midnight.
